stem: Which sentence best supports the author’s message about staying positive after receiving bad news?

options.label: A
options.text: All of their plans—staying up late playing games and reading stories by flashlight in their awesome new tent—were gone. (paragraph 13)

options.label: B
options.text: "Dad, can you get the new tent and some flashlights from the car?" Kim said hopefully. (paragraph 14)

options.label: C
options.text: Dad smiled, opened the car door, and searched, finding the two flashlights sandwiched between the portable stove and bottled water. (paragraph 15)

options.label: D
options.text: "Need help?" he asked, handing the items to Kim. (paragraph 16)
